sources.content: # mubrine/search. This image runs the Mubrine full text search server. It is based on `eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine` and runs as the user `mubrine` (UID 1500, GID 1500). The HTTP API listens on port 7820, and port 7821 carries cluster traffic between nodes. Index data lives in the volume `/var/lib/mubrine`; mount persistent storage there or every restart starts with an empty index. The entrypoint is `/opt/mubrine/bin/mubrine-server`, and it takes no arguments by default.

Configuration. `MUBRINE_HEAP` sets the JVM heap and defaults to `1g`. `MUBRINE_CLUSTER_NAME` defaults to `mubrine-local`. `MUBRINE_API_KEY` has no default; when it is unset the server refuses to start unless `MUBRINE_DEV_MODE=true`. `MUBRINE_REFRESH_INTERVAL` controls how often new documents become searchable and defaults to `1s`. The health check calls `GET /health` on the API port every 15 seconds with a 3 second timeout. Send SIGTERM to stop the server; it flushes open segments before exiting.
